topic.title: Spiking Neural Networks and Temporal Coding
topic.overview: Spiking networks represent information through discrete events and their timing. Training must handle discontinuous firing while controlling latency, spike count, and predictive accuracy. The represented work studies temporal gradients, information bottlenecks, conversion from conventional networks, and self-supervised representations suitable for event-driven computation.
topic.whyItMatters: Sparse activity can reduce energy on appropriate hardware, but an inefficient temporal code may require so many steps that savings disappear. Training quality and deployment efficiency therefore need to be assessed together.
topic.evolution: The 1996 representatives analyze temporal coding and rapid processing through asynchronous spikes. Later work develops more precise backpropagation over neuronal state and firing times. Recent methods add self-supervised visual learning, time-to-first-spike training, and joint weight-and-spike sparsification. These are different routes to useful temporal computation, not evidence that every spiking implementation is inherently faster or more efficient.
openQuestions: How can temporal learning reduce latency without discarding useful timing information?
Which reported efficiency gains survive deployment on realistic neuromorphic hardware?

papers.title: Bullet Trains: Parallelizing Training of Temporally Precise Spiking Neural Networks
papers.tldr: Parallel spike processing and differentiable timing solvers make exact continuous-time spiking networks practical to train on GPUs.

papers.title: Efficient Transformer Attention for SNNs via Hadamard Simplification
papers.tldr: SSA and USSA simplify spiking-transformer attention to reduce computation and communication while maintaining strong image-classification results.

papers.title: Efficiently Training Time-to-First-Spike Spiking Neural Networks from Scratch
papers.tldr: A coordinated training framework improves stability, latency, and accuracy in spiking networks that encode information with one spike per neuron.

papers.title: Emergent Visual Representations through Unsupervised Spiking Networks with Synaptic Pruning
papers.tldr: An unsupervised spiking network develops brain-aligned visual representations that improve further when weak or redundant synapses are pruned.

papers.title: Error Amplification Limits ANN-to-SNN Conversion in Continuous Control
papers.tldr: CRPI carries residual membrane potentials across control steps to reduce error amplification when converting trained networks into spiking networks.

papers.title: Frequency Matching in Spiking Neural Networks for mmWave Sensing
papers.tldr: Matching spiking-neuron dynamics to useful mmWave signal frequencies improves tested accuracy and theoretical energy efficiency.

papers.title: HelioX: A GPU-Native Framework for Simulation and Training of Biophysically Detailed Networks
papers.tldr: HelioX uses biology-aware GPU kernels to accelerate detailed neural simulation and enable large biophysical models to train on a single consumer GPU.

papers.title: LIF Recurrent Memory Enables Long-Horizon Spiking Computation
papers.tldr: A recurrent microcircuit of simple spiking neurons improves long-term memory, sequence-task accuracy, and computational efficiency.

papers.title: Narrowing the ANN–SNN Gap for Continuous 1D Temporal Signal Classification with Multi-Scale Temporal Encoding and Sparsity-Regularized Transform Encoding
papers.tldr: Multi-scale and sparsity-regularized encoding improve spiking networks’ accuracy-efficiency trade-off for continuous temporal signals, sometimes surpassing conventional counterparts.

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Spiking Operators: Breaking the Nonlinearity Bottleneck in Spiking Transformers
papers.tldr: Modular spiking approximations extend Transformer conversion to key nonlinear operators with less than a 1% accuracy drop in the evaluated tasks.

papers.title: Positional Encoding for Spiking Transformers
papers.tldr: SPE encodes position through spiking-neuron thresholds and dynamics, improving sequence modeling without additional trainable parameters.

papers.title: Practical Mechanism for Fault-Tolerant Spiking Neural Networks via Simple Input Control Based on Learnable Fragmentation
papers.tldr: Learned input fragmentation improves spiking-network fault tolerance without accessing internal circuits, including on a physical FPGA platform.

papers.title: Resolving the Timestep Scaling Paradox in Spiking Neural Networks with a Timestep-Scalable Neuron Model
papers.tldr: The TS neuron combines long-term information flow with controlled forgetting to make additional timesteps beneficial in the reported spiking-network evaluations.

papers.title: Rethinking Attention in Spiking Transformers: Overcoming Density Bias with Set Similarity
papers.tldr: DiceFormer normalizes spiking attention for firing density, helping sparse but relevant spike patterns contribute to predictions.

papers.title: SMM Transformer: Leveraging Spiking Neural Networks for Multimodal Tasks
papers.tldr: SMM Transformer combines stable spiking training, spike-based attention, and modality-aware experts with competitive accuracy and lower estimated attention energy.

papers.title: SmoothSpike: Spiking Transformer with Learnable Hadamard Transformation
papers.tldr: SmoothSpike smooths spiking Transformer inputs to reduce saturation-driven information loss and improve language-task performance.

papers.title: Spectra: Rethinking Optimizers for LLMs Under Spectral Anisotropy
papers.tldr: Spectra suppresses dominant gradient directions to improve language-model training, reporting better accuracy, faster convergence, and lower optimizer costs.

papers.title: Spik4lite: Refactoring Neuromorphic Sparsity for Efficient Spiking Neural Networks on Commodity Edge Devices
papers.tldr: Spik4lite makes spiking networks physically more compact to reduce real edge-device computation and energy use while preserving accuracy.

papers.title: Spike-HTR: Spiking Neural Transformer for Handwritten Text Recognition
papers.tldr: Spike-HTR recognizes handwriting using a two-step coarse-to-fine spiking input and selective compression of blank-heavy sequence regions.

papers.title: SpikeCLR: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Visual Representations with Spiking Neural Networks
papers.tldr: SpikeCLR uses temporal alignment and a training-time surrogate neuron path to learn strong visual representations while retaining fully spiking inference.

papers.title: SpikeNet: Sparse Spike-Driven Mask Vector Transformer for Energy-Efficient and Stable Spiking Point Cloud Processing
papers.tldr: SpikeNet combines binary-mask attention and sparse spiking residual processing for accurate, energy-efficient point-cloud analysis.

papers.title: SpikeVLA: Vision-Language-Action Models with Spiking Neural Networks
papers.tldr: SpikeVLA uses spiking networks throughout perception, reasoning, and action to reduce energy and computation while retaining competitive performance.

papers.title: SpikingLM: Towards Fully Spiking Language Model
papers.tldr: SpikingLM stabilizes spiking language-model training and restores efficient token competition, reporting lower energy use and strong GLUE performance.

papers.title: SVL: Empowering Spiking Neural Networks for Efficient 3D Open-World Understanding
papers.tldr: SVL aligns 3D, image, and text representations to give efficient spiking networks zero-shot recognition and open-world question-answering capabilities.

papers.title: TEFormer: Structured Bidirectional Temporal Enhancement Modeling in Spiking Transformers
papers.tldr: TEFormer combines forward temporal attention with backward recurrent processing to improve Spiking Transformer accuracy across encoding choices.

papers.title: Temporal Weighted Encoding: Towards Maximal-Capacity Spike Coding for ANN–SNN Conversion
papers.tldr: Temporal Weighted Encoding represents activations with exponentially weighted spikes, achieving negligible conversion loss with substantially fewer timesteps.

papers.title: Training Deep Spiking Neural Networks without Normalization
papers.tldr: SpikeInit stabilizes firing rates and gradients through initialization, enabling normalization-free training of deep spiking networks, including a 1,000-layer model.

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Spiking DiTs Conversion via Membrane Potential Error-Feedback
papers.tldr: Multi-threshold spikes and cross-step membrane feedback improve energy-efficient Diffusion Transformer conversion without retraining.

papers.title: UniSparse: Combining Weight Pruning and Spike Sparsification in Spiking Neural Networks
papers.tldr: UniSparse jointly reduces spike activity and prunes weights to improve the accuracy–energy trade-off of spiking neural networks.

papers.title: Zeroth-Order Forward-Only SNN Training Inspiring Neuromorphic On-Chip Learning
papers.tldr: SZO trains spiking networks with forward-only updates in a low-dimensional subspace, approaching first-order accuracy while improving learning speed.
